name: Sounding
weather: low cloud, drifting mist in the dolines
designIntent: A quiet reconnaissance of the collapsed dolines: sound a route for the heavies and paint the Directorate's AA nests for a Compact rocket strike. Passive-sensor tutorial and Vireo's nervous first drop.

briefing.speaker: Relay
briefing.text: New terrain, Lodestar, and honestly it's showing off — the karst highlands are all sinkholes, cliff walls, and caves that go down further than my clearance. Here's our problem: the Directorate parked an anti-air umbrella across the dolines, and until it's gone, every rocket truck and resupply flight the Compact owns is grounded. Here's our answer: you. This one's a whisper job. You'll drop into the collapsed dolines, sound out a route our heavies can actually walk, and find their AA nests — we count four, but their emissions overlap, so somebody has to eyeball them. Go passive. No radar sweep, no active pings; you'll see less, but so will they. Paint each nest with the beacon tagger and our rocket teams handle the loud part from twelve klicks away. One more thing: you've got a new wing. Anja Kessler, callsign Vireo. First live drop. She's greener than the map, but Ekene sees something in her. So do I. Bring her home smarter. Relay out.

objectives.title: Sound the Dolines
objectives.description: Survey the three collapsed dolines and confirm a route heavy mechs can walk.

objectives.title: Paint the Nests
objectives.description: Locate all four AA nests and paint each with the beacon tagger.

objectives.title: Danger Close
objectives.description: Hold cover with the fireteam while the Compact rocket barrage lands on the painted nests.

objectives.title: Sweep the Rim
objectives.description: Destroy surviving AA elements after the strike.

objectives.title: Ghost Protocol
objectives.description: Complete all four paints without triggering a sector alert.

enemyForces: Four AA nests: quad-flak turret clusters with swarm-rack emplacements
Active drone pickets sweeping the doline rims
One sentry Chert walking the ridge line
Hover skiff pair patrolling the gorge floor
setPieces: First descent into the karst — sinkholes dropping into blue-dark and cave mouths breathing mist
Going passive: the HUD dims, the radar ring stills, and the world goes quiet
The rocket barrage arcs over the ridge and lands on your paint like a verdict
Vireo's first confirmed kill on the rim sweep — and her first steadying breath
failConditions: Fewer than four nests painted when the barrage window closes
Vireo's mech destroyed on her first drop
Player mech destroyed — pilot ejects, mission failed
salvageNotes: Rocket-struck nests leave flak barrels and swarm-rack cores worth good scrip. The sentry Chert is only claimable if taken quietly before the strike — an alert sends it home. Painted kills credit the whole fireteam.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: Vireo — um, Anja — on your wing, Lodestar. First live drop. I've done the simulations. All of them. Twice. That's... that's not reassuring anyone, is it.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: Breathe, little bird. Simulations don't have me in them. Stay on Lodestar's hip and you'll grow old bragging about today.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Passive mode engaged. Emissions minimized. Your detection range is reduced — and so is your signature. In the karst, silence sees further than radar.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Beacon tagger armed. Hold line of sight on the target for three seconds to confirm paint. Painted coordinates stream to the rocket teams automatically.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: That's a nest all right — quad flak and a swarm rack, dug in like it pays rent. Paint it and drift on. Three more somewhere in the mist.

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Chert on the ridge. Walking its little route. It dies quiet or it goes home — your call, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Drone picket converging on your position. Movement recommended. Passive signature holds only if you do not fire.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Four paints, four nests, zero screaming. Rocket trucks are spinning up — get the team below the rim, this is going to be loud on your behalf.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Birds up! Thirty seconds of the Compact's entire artillery budget — heads down and enjoy the show.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: That was— they're just gone. The whole nest is just... okay. Okay. Sweeping the rim. I can do this part.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: Target down! I— that was mine. Confirmed. ...Tremor, you saw that, right?

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Route's sounded, sky's open, and the new kid shoots straight. Highlands, you're officially in trouble. Come on home, all four of you.
